findings.criterion_5_evidence: Fare refundability is applied: fare_classes.refundable drives policyReason nonrefundable_fare in zero-refund-cancellation.service.ts (landed 2026-11-06, after the 2026-11-05 assessment). Browser journeys on the accepted source: cash cancellation shows the 50% retained fee and the native refund receipt; a fare-only nonrefundable booking requires explicit zero-refund consent and retains a cancellation receipt with the retained fee across reload; split cancellation fulfils both payers with fees and operation receipts; a nonrefundable departure refuses cancellation with no provider refund. Native tests: a nonrefundable fare is never turned into a time-based cash refund; the nonRefundable cancellation penalty is honoured; zero cancellation requires consent, rejects stale quotes, refuses internal or mixed funding without manufacturing a refund, and rolls back with its receipt if the durable event fails. Design limit recorded, not a gap: zero-refund cancellation of internally or mixed-funded bookings is refused explicitly and routed to reconciliation.
